text: agent-discord-presence 将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 和 DeepSeek Harness 的会话状态同步到 Discord Rich Presence。本地服务显示当前 agent 的工作、等待、空闲或错误状态，可自动选择或手动固定会话。它还能在回复完成后生成活动摘要，并自定义标题、图标和按钮。适合希望在 Discord 展示编码状态的开发者。需要 Node.js 22 和 Discord 桌面应用；摘要默认使用当前会话模型，也可配置兼容 OpenAI 的模型服务。

agent-discord-presence shares Discord Rich Presence for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness. Its local service displays session state and optional generated summaries. Users can pin sessions and customize activity text and images. Requires Node.js 22 and Discord desktop.

多个 AI 编程客户端能共用一个 Discord Rich Presence 服务吗？
希望 Discord 能标出 agent 正在处理、等待我确认，还是已经空闲。
让编码 agent 完成回复后自动生成简短的 Discord 活动标题。
Show my current coding agent's working or idle state in Discord.
Can one Discord presence service track sessions from several coding agents?
I want a short activity title in Discord after my agent finishes a reply.
agent-discord-presence 的功能「多客户端状态」：接收 Codex 和 Claude Code 钩子，以及 OpenCode、Pi、DeepSeek Harness 事件，并映射为共享会话状态。
agent-discord-presence 的功能「Discord 活动展示」：本地服务选择当前会话，把 agent、阶段、摘要标题和副标题渲染为 Discord 活动内容，并支持时间戳、图标和按钮等选项。
agent-discord-presence 的功能「摘要生成与模型选择」：会话完成后可根据回复内容生成活动标题和副标题；默认使用当前客户端会话模型，也可配置 OpenAI-compatible 服务。
agent-discord-presence 的功能「会话选择与置顶」：可通过命令固定某个 agent 会话显示，取消固定后恢复自动选择；服务状态也可查看连接和会话信息。
agent-discord-presence 使用自动摘要时，会把完成回复的文本交给当前会话模型或配置的摘要服务来生成活动标题；可通过配置禁用自动摘要。
Let me choose which active agent session appears on my Discord profile.

agent-discord-presence README · Agent Discord Presence：Discord Rich Presence for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness, powered by one local service that keeps your active work visible in Discord.

> [!NOTE]\
> This project is in early development, so expect frequent changes.

agent-discord-presence README · Features：- Generates a summary title, subtitle, activity state, and elapsed session time for your active agent work.
- Selects the active session across supported agents, reconnects to Discord, and clears stale sessions automatically.
- Uses the current agent model by default for summaries, with optional custom model, service, language, and prompt styling.
- Sends up to 4,000 characters of the completed assistant reply to the summarization model and includes model usage metadata.
- Allows automatic summaries to be disabled while keeping lifecycle updates enabled.
- Runs multiple agents together with [independent model, prompt, and display settings](USAGE.md#independent-configuration-for-each-agent).

agent-discord-presence README · Quick start：You'll need Node.js 22+ and the Discord desktop app. Open Discord and sign in before checking your presence. A default Discord Application ID is included; no bot token is needed.

Prefer to set it up yourself? Install the package and start the service in the background:

```sh
npm install --global agent-discord-presence
adp start -b
```

Then follow the setup instructions for your agent:

agent-discord-presence README · Quick start：Stop the service with `adp stop`; this clears its Discord activity. To run in the foreground instead, use `adp start` and stop it with Ctrl+C. Automatic startup is not configured, so run `adp start -b` again after restarting your computer.
